mcqs.question: Which statement about staging systems is made in the 2023 ESGO vulvar cancer guideline?

options.A: Only a local institutional staging system is accepted
options.B: FIGO and TNM are both used and are closely aligned, and FIGO staging was last reviewed in 2021
options.C: TNM has been withdrawn for vulvar cancer
options.D: FIGO staging for vulvar cancer was last revised in 1988 and is unchanged
options.E: Clinical staging without pathology is preferred to FIGO

mcqs.correctAnswerText: FIGO and TNM are both used and are closely aligned, and FIGO staging was last reviewed in 2021
mcqs.explanation: The guideline states that FIGO and TNM are both used, are closely aligned, and that FIGO staging was last reviewed in 2021.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The FIGO staging system was last reviewed in 2021 by the FIGO Committee on Gynecologic Oncology

mcqs.question: For clinically palpable (suspicious or bulky) inguinofemoral nodes, what does the ESGO text identify as the method of choice for preoperative assessment?
mcqs.explanation: The guideline says ultrasound examination alone is the method of choice for that preoperative assessment, including distance of metastasis from skin and vessels.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Ultrasound examination alone is the method of choice for pre-operative assessment

mcqs.question: Which procedure is explicitly within the scope of the 2023 ESGO vulvar cancer guideline?
mcqs.explanation: The guideline’s scope includes the sentinel lymph node procedure together with groin treatment, surgery, and (chemo)radiotherapy.

mcqs.question: Besides surgery, which treatment categories does the 2023 ESGO vulvar guideline set out to cover?

options.B: (Chemo)radiotherapy, systemic treatment, and treatment of recurrent disease
options.C: Only palliative care, with no primary treatment

mcqs.correctAnswerText: (Chemo)radiotherapy, systemic treatment, and treatment of recurrent disease
mcqs.explanation: The introduction lists (chemo)radiotherapy, systemic treatment, and treatment of recurrent disease among the domains covered.

sourceRefs.excerpt: (chemo)radiotherapy, systemic treatment, treatment of recurrent disease

mcqs.question: When does the ESGO text call for ultrasound of the groins to confirm suspicion and to measure distance from skin and blood vessels?

options.A: Only after distant metastasis is proven
options.B: When inguinofemoral nodes are clinically palpable (suspicious or bulky)
options.C: In every patient with a normal groin examination

mcqs.correctAnswerText: When inguinofemoral nodes are clinically palpable (suspicious or bulky)
mcqs.explanation: Ultrasound is described for clinically palpable suspicious or bulky inguinofemoral nodes, to confirm the finding and to assess distance from skin and vessels.

sourceRefs.excerpt: if the inguinofemoral lymph nodes are clinically palpable (suspicious or bulky)
